Subject: SDLC orchestration evidence request: code review gates & change approvals

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of Arcadia Financial's SIG intake we need a compact evidence bundle focused on how code review, CI gating, secrets management, and change approvals are enforced for production-facing services. Specifically can you provide the following artifacts (or internal links) by EOD PDT tomorrow if possible: 

- One representative PR that shows branch protection enforcement + at least two reviewer approvals (redacted if needed).
- CI pipeline YAML (or screenshot) that shows gating stages (build -> test -> policy -> canary).
- Merge/approval audit log for March 2028 (CSV or export).
- Description and proof of ephemeral secret rotation (vault token rotation schedules, OIDC usage for runners).
- Commit-signing policy and an example signed commit or signature verification output.
- Any change-management notes showing emergency patch exceptions and who authorized them.

If any of these items are too sensitive to share verbatim, a redacted artifact plus a short attestation explaining what was redacted will work. Also flag anything that needs a confidentiality or IP NDA before sharing.

SIG reference: SIG-2028-47. Let me know and I can scope down the ask.

Best,
Keri
Senior Assessor
SecureAssess LLC
